title: Doubles Positioning (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 132bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Move as one team
Mirror your partner
Both up or both back
No one alone

[Verse 1]
When partner goes back you go back
When partner steps up you step up
Move together side by side
Close the middle gap mid stride
Vamos vamos as one team
Uno dos tres steady stream
If one is back the other is back
Dont leave them on a track

[Pre-Chorus]
Mirror move
Mirror move
Mirror move
Get in the groove

[Chorus]
Doubles positioning doubles positioning
Mirror partner mirror partner
Doubles positioning doubles positioning
Vamos amigos move smarter

[Verse 2]
Close the middle six feet apart
Not too wide and not too smart
Third shot drop then move forward
Four quick steps then onward
Uno dos tres slide and shift
Mano firme paddle lift
Kitchen line is your home
Dont retreat dont roam

[Bridge]
Transition zone is the danger zone
Move through quick dont stand alone
Three quick steps close the line
Ready stance and you are fine

[Chorus]
Doubles positioning doubles positioning
Mirror partner mirror partner
Doubles positioning doubles positioning
Vamos amigos move smarter

[Outro]
Mirror move
Close the gap
Mirror move
Close the gap
